newsitem.title: UK: Brazil's Petrobras in joint venture talks.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Petrobras in joint venture talks.

text.p: Brazil's state oil company, Petrobras, is talking to 40 companies about joint venture upstream oil and gas projects, a Petrobras official said on Tuesday.

Luiz Costamilan, a senior advisor to chairman of Petrobras, told Reuters Petrobras had put together a package of 160 exploration and production opportunities and was currently assessing reponses from companies.
Asked whether Petrobras has been talking Anglo-Dutch oil giant Shell he said "yes all the majors are there. We see a very clear demonstration of interest"

He was unable to say when concessions would be awarded but said an oil bill amending the constitution, which has already passed through the lower house of congress, will be scrutinised by the senate this week and will have to be completed first.
"We need to see the law approved first" he said adding final approval could come as early as June or July this year.
